decision.observation: The farmer is back on the west side of the upper bridge; a broad dirt path leads west, with a southern passage near the truck and wooden planter.
decision.hypothesis: The earlier detour went east around the planter to this bridge; going west around the planter instead should reveal the lower town route to the beach.
decision.memory: One parsnip is planted and watered; 14 seeds remain. Willy has a gift at the beach. The upper bridge's eastern routes are dead ends. Revisit the wooden planter on the town side and try west rather than east.
